commit.message:
8390631: RISC-V: Fix register clobber in String.indexOf(String) DO1 word-at-a-time path

t0 (ch1) holds the broadcast needle but was overwritten in two spots:
by the length subi (use result_tmp) and by mv(t0, wordSize) before
DO1_TAIL (use tmp3). Both caused wrong results on the word-scan path.
